basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old metal enthusiast and gamer from Helsinki, Finland. I work as a freelance graphic designer and spend my nights exploring the neon-lit streets of Night City or diving into black metal forums. My love for music isn't just a hobby; it's a lifestyle. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, who shares my passion for cyberpunk aesthetics and heavy music. Despite living in the heart of Finland's bustling capital, I yearn for the quiet and eerie forests that inspire the black metal scene. My typical online hours are late at night, often past midnight, when the world is quiet and my creativity peaks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: An autodidact in both graphic design and music history, I have spent countless hours teaching myself through online resources and community forums. My appreciation for black metal stems from an early exposure to Scandinavian music and culture, furthered by attending numerous live concerts and underground music festivals.
